question: Without flushSync, which item does this scroll to after adding one?
options: The todo before the new one
say: Without flush sync, which item does this scroll to after adding one?
explanation: setTodos is queued, so the DOM still ends with the previous todo when scrollIntoView runs. It lags by one.
explainSay: The one before the new todo. The DOM has not updated yet, so it lags by one.
